contract.title: TWIN-58 SoC AP ui_gateway与browser_hmi契约校验、显式动作解耦、离线状态同步与Batch AP-3中文注释补齐
contract.accepted_scope: Docker QA sandbox (deploy_twin.sh --build-only + CTest on build/ui_gateway and Python HMI contract tests) verification of ISS-20261105-006 (/api/v1/state dynamic routing and static fake state cleanup), ISS-20261105-007 (saving slot config decoupled from LOAD/210°C), ISS-20261105-008 (two-stage model load vs start print), ISS-20261105-009 (G-code upload extension/empty/content 400 validation), ISS-20261105-010 (color weight sum and slot/action 400 validation), ISS-20261105-011 (UI bed out-of-range fault display), ISS-20261105-013 (offline OOBE and 4 filament sensors non-green state), ISS-20261105-017 (404 response buffer sizing without truncation), and Batch AP-3 Chinese code comments across ui_gateway + browser_hmi (20 files, ISS-20261105-018). Candidate commit 19534a9a4cb393176882fbad046129d55bba51f6 is the consolidated soc-ap commit for the jointly approved batch TWIN-57/58/59 under APPR-20261105-004 (sibling paths in forward/device_manager and core/middleware/runtime belong to TWIN-57 and TWIN-59 in the same approved batch). Physical HIL verification is out of scope for this software sandbox task (covered by TWIN-55); all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.

dependency_conditions.required: 继承TWIN-56 16-bit seq日志与三仓锁定基线

contract.checkpoint: 开工前绑定；自检单测与注释规范检查；独立沙箱与QA审查；收件

commands.expected: 编译与ui_gateway及browser_hmi全部单元/契约回归测试100%通过，且目标范围内代码中文注释符合code_documentation_standard.md

positive_cases: 修复ISS-20261105-006(/api/v1/state动态路由统一与静态假文件清理)、ISS-20261105-007(保存料槽配置与LOAD/210°C解耦)、ISS-20261105-008(模型一键载入与开始打印两阶段解耦)、ISS-20261105-009(G-code上传扩展名/空文件/内容前后端双重400校验)、ISS-20261105-010(混色权重与槽位/动作越界400校验)、ISS-20261105-011(UI侧热床超量程故障展示)、ISS-20261105-013(设备离线时OOBE与4路断料传感器去假绿)、ISS-20261105-017(404响应缓冲区扩容消除截断)，并同步完成Batch AP-3(ui_gateway + browser_hmi共20个文件)中文代码注释全量补齐(ISS-20261105-018)。
negative_cases: 边界越界、非法参数、超时与断链场景按契约拒绝或降级，无回归破坏
